notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[p]Hi Store owners,  
One of the latest developments we've been working on is how stock bought from different suppliers can influence customers and your resupply options.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QqfXAqA4Y34;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2]Suppliers[/h2][p]When restocking your store, the choice of supplier can impact you in a number of ways :[/p][list][*][p]price of stock[/p][/*][*][p]time it takes to get stock delivered to you[/p][/*][*][p]quality of stock that impacts customers feedback on your store[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/6a3ffefe72f29d506f2ec40780c0580283a2f313.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Competitors[/h2][p]Customers consider the quality of your stock and price compared to competitors and how close those competitors are to your store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/8b929efa6854c00c1a139e22280feb595af2d630.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/channels/1363539450109628659/1363539450109628661"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/de6137e143667d40daa744ff58a07e9ba7c74cb2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/fRockGame "]Facebook[/url] [/p][p][url="https://twitter.com/tRockGame "]Twitter[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/c/RockGameSA"]Youtube[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Our First Devlog
notes.content: [p]Hi Store owners,[/p][p]We're excited as we've just opened our first Sunny Blooms Garden Center Devlog. Dig in and discover what we have plans for.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QqfXAqA4Y34;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Play Test[/h2][p]If you'd like to join our play test then why not sign up for it on our store page.[/p][p][/p][h3]Working On Now[/h3][list][*][p]We are currently looking at making some adjustments to the crate stacking and crashing mechanics to improve the liquid spillage flow[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/f046248d1e619086304bd0729e814975e1ada1a0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Updating calculations for how competitors impact the customer feedback on your store[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/1cf9b29c0f441f5b92c79ac0c473e62c1846c413.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/channels/1363539450109628659/1363539450109628661"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628492/de6137e143667d40daa744ff58a07e9ba7c74cb2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/fRockGame "]Facebook[/url] [/p][p][url="https://twitter.com/tRockGame "]Twitter[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/c/RockGameSA"]Youtube[/url][/p]
